# Fountain Pen Revolution

> > Fountain Pen Revolution offers an extensive catalog of affordable and luxury fountain pens from international brands and proprietary FPR collections, featuring handmade pens from Indian artisans and German-engineered writing instruments.

FPR is a specialized fountain pen retailer showcasing both their own proprietary FPR collection (with German-tipped and 14k gold nibs) and curated selections from premium international brands like Pilot, LAMY, Kaweco, and Platinum. The site emphasizes handcrafted pens from Indian makers like Ranga, Click, Guider, and Kanwrite alongside luxury European manufacturers.

## Key Topics

- FPR Proprietary Collection
- Handmade Fountain Pens
- German-Tipped Nibs
- 14k Gold Nibs
- Luxury Writing Instruments
- Affordable Pens
- Indian Artisan Craftsmanship
- Pilot Fountain Pens
- LAMY Fountain Pens
- Kaweco Fountain Pens
- Ranga Handmade Pens
- Kanwrite Pens
- Acrylic Pens
- Pen-of-the-Day Deals
- Fountain Pen Accessories

## Core Collections

- [Fountain Pen Revolution](https://fprevolutionusa.com): Homepage showcasing FPR's affordable fountain pens and accessories
- [All Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/all-fountain-pens): Complete catalog of all fountain pens available for browsing and purchase
- [FPR Fountain Pen Collection](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/fpr-fountain-pen-collection): FPR's proprietary fountain pen collection with German-tipped nibs
- [FPR Collection - 14k Gold Nibs](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/fpr-collection-14k-gold-nibs): Luxury FPR fountain pens featuring 14k gold nibs and premium materials

## Premium International Brands

- [Pilot Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/pilot-fountain-pens): Pilot luxury fountain pens including Vanishing Point and Custom 823
- [LAMY Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/lamy-fountain-pens): LAMY luxury fountain pens including Safari and Dialog CC models
- [Kaweco Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/kaweco-fountain-pens): Kaweco quality German fountain pens since 1911, including Sport models
- [Platinum Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/platinum-fountain-pens): Platinum fountain pens from Prefounte to Preppy affordable models
- [Opus 88 Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/opus-88-fountain-pens): Opus 88 luxury fountain pens including demonstrator and pocket models
- [Nahvalur Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/nahvalur-fountain-pens): Nahvalur luxury fountain pens with multiple color variants and models
- [Retro 51 Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/retro-51-fountain-pens): Retro 51 aircraft-themed fountain pens including Tornado models
- [Wahl Eversharp Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/wahl-eversharp-fountain-pens): Wahl Eversharp fountain pens including the Skyline collection
- [J. Herbin Fountain and Rollerball Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/j-herbin-fountain-and-rollerball-pens): J. Herbin fountain and rollerball pens with converter and cartridge options

## Handmade Indian Artisan Pens

- [Ranga Handmade Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/ranga-handmade-pens): Ranga handmade fountain pens with 50+ years of South Indian craftsmanship
- [Click Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/click-fountain-pens): Affordable Click fountain pens handmade in Indore, India
- [Guider Handmade Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/guider-fountain-pens): Handmade Guider ebonite pens crafted by Indian artisans in Rajahmundry
- [Kanwrite Fountain Pens](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/kanwrite-fountain-pens): Kanwrite fountain pens from family-owned Kanpur Writers in India

## Special Offers & Accessories

- [Pen-Of-The-Day Deal](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/pen-of-the-day-deal): Daily deals offering 20-50% discounts on popular fountain pen models
- [Calligraphy Sets](https://fprevolutionusa.com/collections/calligraphy-sets): Calligraphy sets and practice sets including J. Herbin products
